findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 217 requests to 50 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 2.3 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 932 kB (41%) came from third-party domains, 926 kB of it from services classified as tracking (204 requests).

39 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising).
129 cookies were set by third-party domains (141 cookies in total).
The address redirected 1 time(s): https://www.theguardian.com/ -> https://www.theguardian.com/us

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 86 requests were blocked. The page still made 217 requests to 50 third-party domains, including 39 tracking services in our list.
